name: Vvaw
description: Vvaw was a planet in the Calaron sector's Vvaw system, which was part of both the Outer Rim Territories and the Slice. It fell within square U-9 of the Standard Galactic Grid. Vvaw was the homeworld of Jedi Master Jmmaar, a ten-legged, crablike Jedi who had been slain by the Separatist General Grievous by 19 BBY.
